L0: # List all prices
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L8: > Nested parameters, fields, and event types on API reference pages are collapsed by default. Use the provided `?query=<name>` links to show the full definitions. Request the page with an empty `?query=` to expand every entry at once.
L9: 
L10: Returns a list of your active prices, excluding [inline prices](https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models.md#inline-pricing). For the list of inactive prices, set `active` to false.
L11: ## Request
L12: 
L13: ```curl
L14: curl -G https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices \
L15:   -u "<<YOUR_SECRET_KEY>>" \
L16:   -d limit=3
L17: ```
L18: ### Response
L19: ```json
L20: {
L21:   "object": "list",
L22:   "url": "/v1/prices",
L23:   "has_more": false,
L24:   "data": [
L25:     {
L26:       "id": "price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh",
L27:       "object": "price",
L28:       "active": true,
L29:       "billing_scheme": "per_unit",
L30:       "created": 1679431181,
L31:       "currency": "usd",
L32:       "custom_unit_amount": null,
L33:       "livemode": false,
L34:       "lookup_key": null,
L35:       "metadata": {},
L36:       "nickname": null,
L37:       "product": "prod_NZKdYqrwEYx6iK",
L38:       "recurring": {
L39:         "interval": "month",
L40:         "interval_count": 1,
L41:         "trial_period_days": null,
L42:         "usage_type": "licensed"
L43:       },
L44:       "tax_behavior": "unspecified",
L45:       "tiers_mode": null,
L46:       "transform_quantity": null,
L47:       "type": "recurring",
L48:       "unit_amount": 1000,
L49:       "unit_amount_decimal": "1000"
L50:     }
L51:   ]
L52: }
L53: ```
L54: ## Returns
L55: 
L56: A dictionary with a `data` property that contains an array of up to `limit` prices, starting after prices `starting_after`. Each entry in the array is a separate price object. If no more prices are available, the resulting array will be empty.
L57: ## Parameters
L58: 
L59: - `active` (boolean, optional)
L60:   Only return prices that are active or inactive (e.g., pass `false` to list all inactive prices).
L61: 
L62: - [`created`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/list.md?query=created) (object, optional)
L63:   A filter on the list, based on the object `created` field. The value can be a string with an integer Unix timestamp, or it can be a dictionary with a number of different query options.
L64: 
L65: - `currency` (enum, optional)
L66:   Only return prices for the given currency.
L67: - `ending_before` (string, optional)
L68:   A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.
L69: 
L70: - `limit` (integer, optional)
L71:   A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
L72: - `lookup_keys` (array of strings, optional)
L73:   Only return the price with these lookup_keys, if any exist. You can specify up to 10 lookup_keys.
L74: 
L75: - `product` (string, optional)
L76:   Only return prices for the given product.
L77: 
L78: - [`recurring`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/list.md?query=recurring) (object, optional)
L79:   Only return prices with these recurring fields.
L80: - `starting_after` (string, optional)
L81:   A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.
L82: 
L83: - `type` (enum, optional)
L84:   Only return prices of type `recurring` or `one_time`.
L85: Possible enum values:
L86:   - `one_time`
L87:   - `recurring`
